messages:
sasha: Heads up from support: customer observed lots of wasted GPU cycles when mobile clients disconnect and immediately retry. The retry lands behind the orphaned work and waits ~30s. Can we design a safer reclaim+preempt flow for the edge?

priya: Oof. We need three properties: (1) low false-positive reclaim, (2) deterministic matching of retries to originals, (3) minimal API churn.

tom: I sketched a design: introduce a short-lived lease token attached to work. Lease is soft (non-authoritative) and expires after a configurable ms. If a retry arrives with same fingerprint and higher retry-version, it can steal the lease if idempotency allows.

qa: How do we compute fingerprint? Need canonicalization rules: trim whitespace, normalize stop tokens order, include model+temperature, but exclude transient headers. Use SHA256 truncated to 64 bits.

sasha: Agreed on fingerprint. Proposal fields: `X-RW-Fingerprint`, `X-RW-Retry-V`, `X-RW-Lease-Expiry-ms`. We can pack them into `X-RW-Retry-Meta` as `fp=ac12;v=2;lease=350`.

priya: Implementation details: on disconnect we mark the stream as "abandoned" and set the lease expiry to now+lease-ms. During lease period the worker continues computation but is marked stealable. If a matching retry shows up, worker can be signalled to gracefully checkpoint and yield.

tom: Graceful checkpointing caveat: not all runtimes support fast checkpoint. For non-checkpointable models we can use two strategies: (A) cold-swap: kill and trigger new cold start (higher latency), or (B) hedge-run: start retry in parallel on separate slot and cancel whichever completes first (costly). Choose per-model policy in model catalog `reclaim_policy: checkpoint|cold_swap|hedge`.

qa: Hedging is scary cost-wise. Default catalog entry should be `checkpoint` if supported else `cold_swap`. Ops can opt-in to hedging for ultra-low-latency customers with dedicated capacity.

sasha: On detection: unify FIN/WS close/HTTP2 RST into a single `client.disconnect` event in tracing. Edge should only mark abandoned if we see explicit close OR no keepalive heartbeats for N ms. We must avoid marking for transient TCP resets.

priya: Keepalives: add passive keepalive tracking at gateway, and expose `edge.keepalive_missed` metric. Also clients should be encouraged to send a small client ACK heartbeat over the stream; we can add a recommended pattern to the SDKs.

tom: Queue semantics: workers will hold two queues: active and stealable. Active = normal. Stealable = active but with lease. Scheduler prefers fresh arrivals but respects model `preempt_friendly` flag. Pseudocode: `if incoming.is_retry and fingerprint in stealable and model.preempt_friendly and incoming.retry_v > stored.retry_v: send_yield(); assign_slot(incoming)`.

qa: What about shared sessions (multi-client reading same stream)? We should never preempt those. Require header `X-RW-Session-Owner=client-id` and only allow reclaim if `Session-Owner` matches or is absent.

sasha: Billing: emit `edge.tokens.consumed{state=aborted|completed|stolen}`. For now bill what ran; we can add a later refunds pipeline if product asks. Also expose `edge.reclaim.count` and `edge.reclaim.latency_savings` for measuring impact.

priya: Compatibility note: when fingerprint absent, fall back to existing behavior (no preemption). That keeps clients opt-in. We should add a migration doc for SDKs: auto-populate fingerprint and retry-v.

tom: Tests: QA to run a matrix of flaky disconnects vs retry intervals: 50ms, 200ms, 500ms, 2s. Measure wasted GPU time and 95/99 latencies under repair policies. I'll add a test harness simulating mobile NAT churn.

qa: I'll add unit+integration tests and a synthetic load test ramp in staging. Also add a Canary flag in the control plane so we can enable per-customer.

sasha: Security/process: ensure fingerprint hash is collision-resistant and doesn't leak prompt contents in logs. Log only truncated hex of fingerprint. Also make sure `X-RW-Retry-Meta` can't be used to spoof billing credits client-side; validate headers against control-plane assigned session tokens.

ops-bot: Note: scheduled staging experiment 2026-04-10T07:00Z to run with lease=250ms,500ms,1000ms. Will post results in #eng-sre.

priya: Next steps: I'll draft a 1-page RFC with: fingerprint rules, lease semantics, model reclaim policy, headers (compact meta), metrics, and rollout plan. Tom will instrument scheduler, QA will own tests, Sasha will own metrics and canary.

sasha: Thanks team. I'll also add a small `/rw debug leases` endpoint to the support CLI to inspect live stealable leases.

priya: One more thought: allow server-suggested lease extension via `Lease-Extend` RPC from worker to edge when it needs more time to checkpoint. That avoids unnecessary cold swaps.

tom: Good idea. We'll include backpressure window and a max-extend count.

sasha: Great. Let's keep messages brief in the RFC and include a flow diagram. I'll create the RFC draft and ping this thread. :thumbsup:
